note: The Merchant Promotions page https://www.ocbc.com.hk/personal-banking/cards/card-promotions is a JavaScript shell. cardpromotions-v1.js loads this public JSON file (the ?prod= file promotions-prod-v1.json is only used when the URL has a prod query and is not the default listing). The file is a top-level array. Keep items with language en only; zh and sc are the same deals in Traditional and Simplified Chinese. Take dates from popup.terms, not from the date object, when they differ (the date.end value is often 31/01/27, past the terms end date). Leave out offers whose terms end date is before the run date. Tiles have no href; terms are in the listing popup, with further PDFs under /iwov-resources/hk/ocbc/personal/pdf/. Sign-up and spending offers for the mass OCBC Credit Card also appear on https://www.ocbc.com.hk/personal-banking/campaign/sem-promotion and must be read with this listing. Do not use an em dash in a title or a published quote.
